title: What It Actually Takes to Deploy GenAI Applications to Enterprises: Arjun Bansal and Trey Doig
talk_summary: A vendor talk from Echo AI (customer-support analytics) and Log10 (LLM eval infra) about achieving trustworthy LLM accuracy at enterprise scale. The transferable core is their 'auto-feedback' approach: fine-tuned, annotator-specific LLM judges trained with bootstrap synthetic data to approximate human review cheaply, then used for monitoring, triage, and dataset curation.

takeaways.technique: Fine-tuned annotator-specific LLM judges instead of generic LLM-as-judge
takeaways.what_they_do: They build eval models from ground-truth (input, output, rubric, human feedback) triples, and found aggregate judges are weak; per-annotator fine-tuned judges correlate far better with human scores than off-the-shelf LLM judging.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we were able to get a 45% Improvement in evaluation accuracy by going from aggregate to uh annotator specific models
takeaways.numbers: 45% eval-accuracy improvement; 20 F1-point improvement in one Echo AI use case

takeaways.technique: Bootstrap synthetic data to make judge training sample-efficient
takeaways.what_they_do: They generate synthetic labeled examples to bootstrap fine-tuning of the eval model, so a small set of real human labels goes much further.
takeaways.evidence_quote: achieve the accuracy of almost as if we had 1,000 uh ground truth labeled examples with just using 50 ground truth examples

takeaways.technique: Cheap local judge first, escalate to stronger model
takeaways.what_they_do: Their SDK runs auto-feedback locally on a simpler model, then fetches feedback from a more complex cloud model only when needed.
takeaways.evidence_quote: run the auto feedback locally on a simpler model and then fetch feedback from a more complex model that runs on our cloud

takeaways.technique: Auto-feedback for monitoring, triage, and dataset curation
takeaways.what_they_do: They use the continuous quality signal to monitor drift, triage limited human review to the worst cases, and curate high-quality data for prompt/fine-tune improvement.
takeaways.evidence_quote: it can be used for triaging so you make the most optimal use of The Limited human resources

takeaways.technique: Open-source judge models matching GPT-4 eval accuracy
takeaways.what_they_do: They extended auto-feedback to open models and matched proprietary fine-tuned eval accuracy with Mistral-7B and Llama-70B-chat.
takeaways.evidence_quote: match the accuracy of gbd4 and gbt 3.5 fine tune evaluation using mrl 7B and Lama 70b chat
takeaways.numbers: Mistral-7B / Llama-70B matched GPT-3.5/4 fine-tuned eval accuracy

takeaways.technique: Human override captured as training signal
takeaways.what_they_do: Their UI lets a human correct an auto-grade, and those overrides are collected as high-fidelity labels to improve the judge and fine-tuning datasets.
takeaways.evidence_quote: I could come in here and change the point value and uh accept it
